orchestration_result.query: Set up a six-year framework agreement for management consulting services.

services.analysis: Two-lot framework agreement for management consulting services, with lot allocation weights. Lot 1 will handle operational consulting and Lot 2 will focus on strategic consulting. The procedure will be open, and awards will be made based on the combination of the best price and the most qualified response, with weights of 60% and 40%, respectively.
services.conflict_of_interest_screening: Conflicts of interest will be screened through an annual declaration of interest from staff members involved in the procedure and review of any potential conflicts by senior management.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: A six-year framework agreement for management consulting services is acceptable, with the two lots of operational consulting and strategic consulting being awarded separately, with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality. However, please note that the lots do not exceed the 60% maximum share of the annual procurement budget for services. The framework agreement will include a screening for conflicts of interest through an annual declaration of interest from staff members involved in the procedure, reviewed by senior management. The estimated value is 220,000 EUR for each lot, for a total estimated value of 440,000 EUR, and the framework duration is 6 years (four years originally proposed in the services sub-agent's report, plus two extension options), as the maximum duration required under the Directive is not violated.
